summary: Iteration 35: Verified ALL 5 key fixes for WhatsApp bot issues. All 30 backend tests passed. (1) Greeting detection: GREETING_WORDS set prevents product search on 'hola', 'buenas', 'buenos dias', etc. (2) base_url now reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from os.environ FIRST. (3) should_search no longer requires has_name and is False when is_greeting is True. (4) SYSTEM_PROMPT: link is OBLIGATORIO, codes NUNCA without link, no products = 'agente enviara catalogo completo, espere unos minutos'. (5) user_prompt reinforces all rules. Fallback appends catalog_link if AI didn't include it.

verification: GREETING_WORDS = {'hola', 'buenas', 'buenos', 'hey', 'saludos', 'buen', 'buenos dias', 'buenas tardes', 'buenas noches', 'buen dia', 'que tal'}
is_greeting checks msg_lower in GREETING_WORDS, startswith patterns, and word intersection
should_search = not is_data_input and not has_code_pattern and not is_greeting

fix_2_base_url_from_env.fix: Now reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from os.environ FIRST, then CATALOG_BASE_URL, then frontend/.env as last resort
verification: if not base_url: try reading frontend/.env

fix_3_should_search_no_has_name.fix: Removed has_name dependency from should_search condition
verification: should_search = not is_data_input and not has_code_pattern and not is_greeting

fix_4_system_prompt_rules.fix: Updated SYSTEM_PROMPT with OBLIGATORIO link, NUNCA codes without link, and 'agente enviara catalogo completo' for no results
